provisional_note: Every recorded_value/recorded_ratio below was captured this session via xd://browser (Puppeteer, macOS headless Chromium) running the SAME scripts/lib/prod-parity-measure.mjs measureEntry() the refresh script and this spec both use — not copy-pasted from an earlier session's report. This is NOT yet the canonical capture: it was run on a macOS box with real Apple CJK fonts (Songti/Hiragino/STKaiti), not the ubuntu-latest runner tests/e2e/prod-parity.spec.ts's own CI job runs on. Per R6 (visual-invariants.spec.ts), CJK font availability can shift text-metric-dependent geometry by 40%+ between environments; the .example/ru width entries below are in-flow CJK glyph-advance sums, so they are NOT provably font-independent despite being 'absolute-px' — they matched byte-exact prod<->branch ONLY because both sides of THIS capture ran under the same macOS font set, which proves nothing about font-bare CI stability. tests/e2e/prod-parity.spec.ts treats provisional:true as report-only (annotates + console-warns on mismatch, never fails the build). Before flipping this flag to false, run `vp run refresh:prod-parity` from an environment with IDENTICAL font availability to the e2e CI job (ubuntu-latest, or a matching container) so the recorded_value baseline and every future CI comparison run share one font environment by construction, then re-verify each entry's tolerance still holds.

NOT SEEDED — prod (00f47bd) and this branch structurally DIVERGE here on purpose. Prod computes `list-style-type: circle` on `.dropdownMenuRoot` (a still-open, pre-#152-vintage Bootstrap CSS-module port gap — verified live: prod ul[data-asset-id] shows listStyleType:circle, firstItemHeight 33.14px with padding 5px 8px 5px 0px yet UA default circle bullets, an inherited legacy quirk never fixed on prod itself), while this branch's 406de90 (`fix: reset list-style on dropdown root menu`) explicitly ADDS `list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 5px 0` to `.dropdownMenuRoot` to fix the #152 CSS-module-port regression against the INTENDED (not prod's actual rendered) Bootstrap 3.4.1 `.dropdown-menu` behavior. Since the fix target is Bootstrap's design intent rather than prod's own current (already-known-buggy) rendering, a byte-for-byte prod-parity assertion here would be asserting a wrong, un-fixed value. Already covered by its own dedicated regression guard: tests/e2e/navbar-dropdown-list-style.spec.ts. Do not seed until/unless prod itself is confirmed to match the fixed behavior.
